name: nginx-multisite
description: Configures an Nginx reverse proxy and static web server for three SSL-enabled virtual hosts, including document roots, security headers, rate limiting, redirects, TLS, and host hardening.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis as local caching services, including Redis authentication, directories, service enablement, and configuration management.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Provisions a FastAPI application from Git, installs Python and PostgreSQL prerequisites, creates a virtual environment and database, and runs Uvicorn under systemd.
